knobs.name: sP
knobs.what: world units per orbit unit: the size of the tangle (where each planet is)

knobs.name: sL
knobs.what: world units per unit of spin: the radius of the six shells, and of the rings inside the layers

knobs.name: sW
knobs.what: world units per unit of the weight-space picture (the network, before its sort)

knobs.name: sC
knobs.what: world units per unit of the fixed sum: the radius of the network shells

knobs.name: layerGap
knobs.what: world units between two energy layers

knobs.name: dotR

knobs.name: dotRNet
knobs.what: dot radius of the 10,000 network dots

knobs.name: hookDotK
knobs.what: dot size factor while only our planet's 100 dots are on stage (0-60 s)

knobs.name: planetR
knobs.what: radius of our moving planet (the one dot that moves with the clock)

knobs.name: sizeCue
knobs.what: how much nearer dots are drawn larger (depth size cue)

knobs.name: fog
knobs.what: fog toward the far side of the cloud

knobs.name: featHi
knobs.what: how far our planet's dots are mixed toward ink: brighter, not bigger

knobs.name: featDim
knobs.what: how far the other dots sink toward the ground while our planet is followed

knobs.name: shellDim
knobs.what: how far the other shells' dots sink while our planet's shell is lit

knobs.name: shellRing
knobs.what: opacity of the thin outline ring drawn round each shell (its silhouette as the camera sees it)

knobs.name: shellStep
knobs.what: the '6 shells' hold: seconds each shell stays lit as they light one at a time, inner to outer

knobs.name: trackA
knobs.what: opacity of the thin line through our planet's 100 dots while it is followed on its shell and in its layer

knobs.name: stag
knobs.what: stagger of the sorts: each orbit's dots leave together, orbits leave up to this fraction apart

knobs.name: wireR
knobs.what: radius of the guide dots (our planet's path, Earth's ellipse)

knobs.name: featOrbit

knobs.name: perS
knobs.what: film seconds per turn of our planet round its sun

knobs.name: laterShift
knobs.what: start the clock later: how far ahead the planet jumps (a fraction of one turn)

knobs.name: turnDeg
knobs.what: turn the whole picture: degrees about its own axis

knobs.name: spinF
knobs.what: length of the flat spin bar (distance × speed around), fraction of the full bar

knobs.name: enF
knobs.what: length of the flat energy bar, fraction of the full bar

knobs.name: pX
knobs.what: left edge of the readout panel (the right third of the stage)

knobs.name: barW
knobs.what: full length of a bar in the panel

knobs.name: barH
knobs.what: height of a bar in the panel

knobs.name: barMax
knobs.what: Earth's two product bars: the value a full bar stands for (million km × km/s; both on one scale)

knobs.name: honestSize
knobs.what: type size of the honest line (in the panel, 141.6-149.9 s)

knobs.name: earthTheta
knobs.what: direction of Earth's closest point in the picture (degrees)

knobs.name: arrowK
knobs.what: world units per km/s for Earth's speed arrows

knobs.name: earthDot
knobs.what: radius of Earth's two lit moments

knobs.name: ringR
knobs.what: world units: radius of the smoke ring

knobs.name: ringTube
knobs.what: world units: radius of the ring's tube

knobs.name: ringW
knobs.what: radians per second the air circles round the tube

knobs.name: ringV
knobs.what: world units per second the ring travels

knobs.name: fov
knobs.what: vertical field of view (degrees), the same in every shot

knobs.name: lensX
knobs.what: lens shift: the subject sits left of the centre by this fraction of the half width (clear of the panel)

knobs.name: lensY
knobs.what: lens shift up (fraction of the half height), clear of the caption band

knobs.name: camWideDist
